metadata.intro: Welcome to the Condensed Matter Physics gateway. This roadmap connects the foundational principles of the field to its modern mathematical frontiers.

pillars.title: 1. Crystal Lattices & Phonon Dynamics
pillars.narrative: The geometry of periodic structures and the quantization of their mechanical vibrations.

pillars.title: 2. Electronic Band Structure
pillars.narrative: How the periodic potential of a lattice dictates the behavior of electrons, leading to the distinction between metals, insulators, and semiconductors.

pillars.title: 3. Magnetism & Collective Ordering
pillars.narrative: The emergence of macroscopic magnetic ordering from microscopic exchange interactions and spin dynamics.

pillars.title: 4. Superconductivity & Superfluidity
pillars.narrative: The breakdown of electrical resistance and fluid viscosity through the formation of macroscopic quantum condensates.

pillars.title: 5. Topological Phases & Modern Frontiers
pillars.narrative: The classification of phases beyond spontaneous symmetry breaking, governed by global topological invariants.
